spans.s: (Naigh. iii, 15; √ गृध् ?) clever, dexterous, judicious, wise, RV.
the god of love, Uṇ. (cf. रथ-गृत्स॑.)
गृ॑त्स—पति (गृ॑त्˚), m. the chief of a number of sharpers, VS. xvi, 25.
गृत्स—मति m. ‘clever-minded’, N. of a son of Su-hotra,

गृत्स—मद॑ m. N. of a son of Śaunaka of Bhṛgu's family (formerly a son of Śuna-hotra [Su-hotra, VP.; BhP.] of the family of Aṅgiras, but by Indra's will transferred to the Bhṛgu family; author of most of the hymns of RV. ii), RAnukr.; ĀśvŚr. xii, 10, 13; ĀśvGṛ. iii, 4, 2; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; MBh. xiii; Hariv. &c.
गृत्स—मद॑ m. pl. Gṛtsamada's family, RV. ii, 4, 9; 19, 8; 39, 8; 41, 18.
